in_sanskrit.name: दुर्लभ
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Durlabhi is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘durlabh’ which means ‘rare’, ‘precious’, or ‘invaluable’. It is a name that signifies the value and significance of the one bearing it. It is a name that is cherished and held dear, as it is not easily found or acquired.
